name: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr.
note: Starting point of the line. Dates for living people are kept out of this repo; the Duska ledger holds them.

name: Kevin John Duska
note: Link in the chain only. Not researched here.

name: Stefan (Štefan) Duska
note: Son of Michal Duska and Maria Demko by the 1947 certificate. Marked as dead on the strength of the burial photograph's label (a prior). The Duska agent owns this entry.

name: Mihaly (Michal, Mike) Duska
note: Roman Catholic cottar of Senné in 1929; 'Mike Duska' in Montréal; married once, to Maria Demko; alive in November 1966. The Duska agent owns this entry. Not to be confused with Mihály Demkó, his father-in-law (ledger X-002).

name: Maria Demko (Mária Demkó, Mary Demko)
role: Great-grandmother. Head of this repo's line
note: Wife of Michal (Mike) Duska and mother of Štefan: documented by the 1947 certificate, the gravestone and the 1966 deed. Greek Catholic, of Iňačovce. Died 9 Sep 1950. The birth date and parents come from the 1906 civil registration; that she is the child in it rests on three points agreeing (name, Iňačovce, 1906) and not yet on a record that states it. See DM-H-010 and DM-H-015.

name: Mihály Demkó

birth.date: c. 1882 (19 Aug 1882 if he is DM-X-001)

note: Greek Catholic agricultural day-labourer living at Solymos in August 1906, born at Magasrév, aged 24; signs his own name. Father of the Mária born 22 Aug 1906. Taken to be the Mihály baptised at Viszoka no. 132 on 20 Aug 1882 (DM-X-001): same name, rite, birthplace and age to the week. That identification is an inference until his marriage entry is found (DM-H-017).

name: Mária Kocsis
note: Greek Catholic, born and living at Solymos, aged 20 in August 1906. Wife of Mihály Demkó. Opens the Kocsis line at Iňačovce.

name: György Demkó
role: Father of Mihály Demkó, if Mihály is the child of 1882
note: Greek Catholic farmer at Viszoka no. 132 in 1882 (same man as DM-X-002). On the line only through the inference at P-018.

name: Mária Hreskó
role: Mother of Mihály Demkó, if Mihály is the child of 1882
note: Roman Catholic (same woman as DM-X-003). On the line only through the inference at P-018.

name: Mihály Demkó
role: Probably the same man as P-018, father of Maria Demko

birth.place: Viszoka (Vysoká nad Uhom) no. 132, Ung county

note: Baptised 20 Aug 1882. The 1906 civil record gives Maria's father as Mihály Demkó, born Magasrév, aged 24: see P-018 and DM-H-010.

name: György Demkó
note: Greek Catholic farmer living at Viszoka no. 132 in August 1882. Born before about 1862.

name: Mária Hreskó
note: Roman Catholic, wife of György Demkó in 1882. Opens a possible Hreskó line.

name: Anna Hreskó
note: Roman Catholic. Shares the mother's maiden surname; probably her sister or sister-in-law.

name: Mihály Varga
note: Roman Catholic. The child may be named for him.

name: Joannes Demko
note: An adult householder of Viszoka on 27 Jan 1803, named in the chapel petition. Born before about 1780. Link to György Demkó of Viszoka no. 132 unproven (DM-H-016).

name: Mária Demkó (the 'maybe' baptism)
role: Probably a different child from Ahn 9
note: Daughter of a Mihály Demkó, cottar, and an Anna. Baptised 27 Feb. See DM-H-015.

name: Mihály Demkó, cottar
note: Not shown to be the same man as P-018. A second Mihály Demkó, or the same man with another wife in another year.
